rows.response_text: XO Burger is a pop-up restaurant located in Santa Barbara, CA, serving sandwiches, burgers, and American traditional cuisine. The restaurant has a casual atmosphere with outdoor seating available. The menu includes a variety of options such as smash burgers, fried chicken sandwiches, and French fries, along with soft serve ice cream. The restaurant is known for its high-quality meat and unique flavors, including a signature black garlic aioli. Customers have given positive reviews for the smash burger and fried chicken sandwich, but some have noted that the French fries can be chewy and overcooked. The restaurant offers limited amenities, such as no Wi-Fi, outdoor seating, or reservations, but customers have praised the friendly service and unique dining experience. Overall, XO Burger is a great option for those looking for tasty, high-quality burgers and a casual dining experience in Santa Barbara.

{"address":"121 E Yanonali St","attributes":{"Ambience":null,"BusinessParking":null,"Music":null,"OutdoorSeating":null,"RestaurantsGoodForGroups":null,"RestaurantsReservations":null,"RestaurantsTakeOut":null,"WiFi":null},"business_stars":3.5,"categories":"Sandwiches, Pop-Up Restaurants, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Burgers","city":"Santa Barbara","hours":{"Friday":"12:0-19:0","Saturday":"12:0-19:0","Sunday":"11:0-16:0"},"name":"XO Burger","review_info":[{"review_date":"2022-01-15 05:34:33","review_stars":3.0,"review_text":"Smashburger was quite good, pretty much what you would expect. Their patty has a bit more chew if that's what you're into. The burger is on the smaller side, so I feel that the wait was too long considering how fast you can kill it.

The chicken sando was very interesting and the slaw was the best part, but I felt that the Sichuan peppercorn flavor was a bit too floral for me.

The fries, though, completely ruined the meal for me. They looked good, but were extremely chewy and not crisp or light. My jaw was sore for the next couple days. The flaked salt used had good texture, but was too heavy handed. 

Black garlic aioli is worth it if you like a little funk.

Would probably eat again if the french fry situation were remedied. But maybe that just comes down to personal preference."},{"review_date":"2022-01-13 01:56:18","review_stars":4.0,"review_text":"My husband and I were dying to try this new pop up place. We ordered fries, smash burger, fried chicken sandwich and shared (this is pretty much all the menu options). They also have soft serve ice cream. Included with the fries is one sauce and every side sauce after is an additional .50. We shared all the items and the smashburger stole the show. The fried chicken sandwich was good but the smashburger was my favorite. It has pickles, cheese, and house sauce on it. I wish we had ordered two fries since the burgers were not huge. Outdoor seating at first looks minimal but in the parking lot there is a huge open area with well spaced out picnic tables."},{"review_date":"2022-01-08 23:56:10","review_stars":4.0,"review_text":"I saw this place being advertised on the Santa Barbara Instagram page, and the picture of the burger got me hooked. I'm here today to try this place out. 
This burger joint shares the location with a coffee shop, so at first I was a little confused. I really like that idea as, I like coffee too. 
We ordered 2 double doubles with fries and 2 sides of secret sauce. The secret sauce is delicious and has a little bite to it. If I had to guess what was the sauce made out of, I would guess thousand island and siracha. 
You can tell the burger is made with quality meat, it taste delicious, i just think if they used a little less secret sauce you would be able to appreciate the burger a lot more. I felt like the sauce over powered the burger. 

One other thing, if you need ketchup for your fries, be aware, it's extra.
